test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the chemical name of saltpetre?
solution:
The correct answer is __potassium nitrate.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Potassium nitrate(KNO3) is also called Saltpetre or Nitre.
 
• It is widely used in Fertilizers, Gunpowder, Rocket Propellants, Firecrackers, food processing, etc. It has also certain pharmacological uses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

** Potassium manganite **

 
• Potassium Permanganate (KMnO4) is an inorganic chemical compound.
 
• It is also known as Condy's crystals or permanganate of potash.

**Lead nitrate**

 
• Lead(II) nitrate is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula Pb(NO3)2. 
 
• It commonly occurs as a colourless crystal or white powder
